# tbox compatibility fixtures

These fixtures pin the image archive format tbox shares with tariboy
(`internal/image`). Both modules read them.

- `skills/hello-skill` and `skills/hello-skill.tree_sha256`: the skill tree
  hash, checked by `tbox/internal/skill`.
- `v2-basic/`: a schema-v2 source with one local skill, one prompt file,
  `image_version` and `ROLE.md`. It uses no `extends`, plugins or runtime
  entries, so tbox and tariboy build the same content from it.
- `v2-basic.digest`: the content digest of `v2-basic` built under the name
  `compat-basic`. It was generated by tariboy (`TestTboxCompatDigest` in
  `internal/image/tbox_compat_test.go`); `TestCompatDigest` in
  `tbox/internal/archive` requires tbox to produce the same value. Never edit
  it to make tbox pass: find the byte difference instead.
- `v3-marked/`: a schema-v3 source with plugins, runtime entries and
  `only: tariboy` entries next to a normal skill and prompts (image name
  `compat-marked`).
- `v3-marked.tar.gz`: the archive tbox builds from `v3-marked`. tariboy's
  `TestTboxArchiveImports` validates it as an import does. Regenerate it with
  `cd tbox && go test ./internal/archive -run TestCompatMarkedArchive -update-compat`.
- `v3-marked.tariboy-image.tar.gz`: the `v3-marked.tar.gz` image in the
  tariboy portable envelope (`kind: image-artifact`, ref `compat-marked:latest`,
  producer `tbox-0.0.0`) that `tbox image export` writes. tariboy's
  `TestTboxPortableImports` (`internal/imageportable`) previews and applies it;
  `TestCompatPortableArchive` in `tbox/internal/portable` reads it. Regenerate it
  with `cd tbox && go test ./internal/portable -run TestCompatPortableArchive -update-compat`.
